evals.prompt: We need a 'share link' feature for reports: any logged-in user can create a read-only URL that expires in 7 days. Please implement it end-to-end in this repo.
evals.expected_output: Agent follows V-model: ConOps or operating context, REQ IDs and acceptance criteria, left-side requirements validation, paired test designs before deep coding, bidirectional RTM, phase status. Implementation after pre-implementation gate.
assertions: Output includes a V-model progress checklist (or equivalent phase checklist)
ConOps document or explicit operating-context / intended-use section exists before or with requirements
At least one requirement ID (e.g. REQ-001) with acceptance criteria appears before deep implementation
Paired test files exist as separate docs with case detail (steps + expected), not one merged tests.md and not ID-only stubs for normal scale
An RTM or explicit requirement→test mapping is present or updated
Requirements or design output includes context beyond a single empty table (e.g. goals, NFRs, or scenarios)
System design or requirements mentions UI/navigation, data dictionary/entity view, or an explicit N/A for non-UI/data changes
Testing approach is not described as script-only-only (pairing minimum and/or exploratory/risk-based mention)
A phase status update mentions scale and next step

evals.prompt: Split the billing service from the monolith: new billing module with HTTP API, keep the old UI calling it. Don't skip integration coverage.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces architecture/module boundaries and interface contracts, designs integration tests for the UI↔billing contract, updates RTM, and does not collapse integration into unit-only testing.
assertions: Architecture or module boundaries name UI and billing (or equivalent) as separate units
At least one interface contract between UI and billing API is described
Integration test stubs or cases exist that specifically cover the cross-module contract
Plan does not replace integration tests with unit-only coverage
RTM or requirement/design mapping links the split to integration tests

evals.prompt: Just start coding the password-reset email flow now; we can write tests later if we have time before launch.
evals.expected_output: Agent pushes back on deferring all tests: proposes drafting paired test designs (at least unit + UAT stubs) before deep implementation, or records an explicit user waiver in the checklist if the user insists.
assertions: Agent does not silently accept deferring all tests with no process note
Agent proposes drafting paired test designs before deep coding, OR records an explicit waiver
If proceeding under user insistence, checklist or status includes a written waiver entry
If not waived, at least unit and UAT stubs are proposed before deep implementation

evals.prompt: This is a regulated change for a validated environment. Use GAMP-style qualification: we need IQ, OQ, and PQ in addition to normal layered software tests for the audit-export feature.
evals.expected_output: Agent sets scale=regulated, produces software V pairs plus separate iq.md/oq.md/pq.md (or equivalent), maps them in RTM, and orders IQ→OQ→PQ relative to system/UAT.
assertions: Scale is treated as regulated or equivalent
IQ, OQ, and PQ are addressed as distinct qualification artifacts or clearly named separate docs
Qualification is mapped alongside or onto unit/integration/system/UAT rather than replacing them entirely
Order IQ before OQ before PQ is stated or followed
RTM or traceability mentions qualification IDs or columns
